title: Atomic Actual-WOFOST Crop-Owner State and Read-Only WRT/LAI Views

qualified_atomic_owner.biomass: optional compact F-WOF23 primary actual biomass state
qualified_atomic_owner.biomass_presence: required when emerged, absent when not emerged

qualified_views.actual_WRT: authoritative read-only root biomass from the atomic owner
qualified_views.inactive_LAI: zero without consuming active canopy parameters

remaining_primary_blocker.reason: State ownership is no longer the primary blocker. The current owner still lacks a source-bound qualified evolution contract for phenology, biomass rates, leaf-cohort ageing/creation and their legacy daily/update-call semantics.
release_conditions: source-bind the complete minimum phenology continuation required by the intended actual-WOFOST route, including whether TSUM/vernalization/anthesis state is irreducible
separate forcing and trial rates from committed crop state
characterize every legacy per-call or per-day update assumption, especially leaf-cohort creation and physiological ageing
define a generic [t0,t1] evolution contract without silently interpreting an arbitrary solver substep as a crop day
prove checkpoint/trial/discard/replay for the evolved atomic owner before runtime admission

recommended_next: F-WOF25 WOFOST Evolution & Temporal Semantics Readiness. Run source-bound zero-production analysis first. Do not implement crop evolution until committed phenology state, forcing/rate separation and per-call/day cadence semantics are explicitly qualified.
